$comment: Hook wiring for the quenching OKF validator, loaded automatically from the plugin's own hooks/hooks.json — no copy to install, no merge into the target repo's .claude/settings.json. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves at load time to this plugin's install path.

PostToolUse.$comment: OKF conformance on every /.knowledge/** edit: validates the touched file against the OKF core (parseable frontmatter + non-empty type on concept docs; index.md is a frontmatter-free listing; log.md is ## YYYY-MM-DD newest-first) and PROPOSES the fix via additionalContext. Exit 0 always (PostToolUse does not undo the edit). Set okfValidate settings in the target repo's .claude/hooks/hooks-config.json to customize.

Stop.$comment: End-of-turn full-bundle sweep: re-validates /.knowledge/ and PROPOSES residual gaps via additionalContext (exit 0). Dirty-gated by default (stopScan:'dirty'): runs only when a /.knowledge/** file was edited since the last completed scan, else exits on one stat. Honors stop_hook_active to avoid loops; deadlineMs aborts a scan mid-walk (marker kept for the next turn).
